question: For Hitachi fiscal 2023, report both (a) renewable electricity generation and its share of electricity usage within the target range, and (b) total Scope 1 and 2 emissions and their share of total Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions.
subject: Hitachi Group
scope_boundary: renewable electricity target range and Hitachi Group GHG reporting boundary

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: Renewable electricity generation across the Hitachi Group in fiscal 2023 amounted to 769 GWh. This amounted to 56% of the electricity usage within the target range
